 Live RSSB CET 12th Level City Slip 2026 (OUT) LIVE: Download Rajasthan CET Exam City Details at rssb.rajasthan.gov.in
 By Deepanshu Upadhayaya Nov 21, 2026, 14:51 IST 
 Rajasthan CET  12th level Exam City: The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board has released RSSB CET 12th Level City Intimation Slip 2026 on November 21, 2026. Candidates who have registered for the Senior Secondary Level examination can check their allotted exam district through the official website at rssb.rajasthan.gov.in. Stay tuned to this live blog for the latest updates on district allotment, direct download link, admit card release date and steps to check exam city details.  
 RSSB CET 12th Level City Slip 2026 (OUT) LIVE: Download Rajasthan CET Exam City Details at rssb.rajasthan.gov.in HIGHLIGHTS 
 RSSB CET 12th Level City Intimation Slip 2026 will be released on November 21, 2026.
 The RSSB CET 12th Level examination will be conducted from December 1 to 3, 2026 in two shifts daily.
 Candidates can download their e-admit cards from November 26, 2026 through the official website at rssb.rajasthan.gov.in.
 Register for Result Updates RSSB CET 12th Level City Slip 2026: The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has released the RSSB CET 12th Level City Intimation Slip 2026 on November 21, 2026. Candidates who have registered for the Common Eligibility Test (Senior Secondary Level) can then check their allotted exam district through the official website at rssb.rajasthan.gov.in. As per the Latest Tweet by RSSB Chairman Alok Raj, the district allotment details will be made available today while the e admit card would be available for download November 26, 2026. Candidates can check this live blog for latest updates, download links and steps to download the exam city details. 
 The RSSB CET 12th Level examination will be conducted from December 1 to 3, 2026. The test will be held in two shifts each day: the morning shift from 10:00 AM to 12:30 PM and the evening shift from 3:00 PM to 5:30 PM. 
 Check-  Rajasthan CET 12TH Level Exam Center List 2026 
 RSSB CET 12th Level City Intimation Slip 2026: Highlights 
 The RSSB CET 12th Level examination serves as a qualifying gateway for several Rajasthan state government recruitments at the Class 12 level. This year the board received a total of 23.56 lakh applications making it one of the largest recruitment examinations in terms of applications received.  RSSB CET 12th Level City Intimation Slip 2026 Download Link 
 The RSSB CET 12th Level City Intimation Slip 2026 is set to be released today November 21, 2026 on the official website. Candidates can then check their allotted examination district once the board publishes the details. The city intimation slip will help to know the district in which the examination centre will be located. We will also provide district allotment details which will be provided below once it is activated. 
 RSSB CET 12TH Level City Slip 2026 Link  
   Click Here 
 How to Download Rajasthan CET 12th Level City Slip 2026? 
 Candidates can follow the steps below to check their allotted exam district: 
 Go to the Rajasthan SSO Portal at sso.rajasthan.gov.in 
 Now you have to visit the recruitment section. 
 Now scroll down and click on the link titled “RSSB CET 12th Level City Intimation Slip 2026”. 
 Now you have to enter login details such as application number and password 
 Submit the details and the exam city allotment will open on your screen. 
 Download and save the city intimation details for future reference. 
 Check-  Rajasthan CET 12th Level Admit Card 2026 Date 
 Details Mentioned on RSSB CET 12th Level City Slip 2026 
 The city intimation slip will provide important details related to the exam. Candidates can check the following details mentioned on the slip- 
 Candidate name and Registration Details 
 Examination name 
 Allotted examination district 
 Examination date 
 Other examination information

 Candidates can download the Rajasthan CET 12th Level City Slip currently the portal is working slow. We will also provide direct download link to you once the link is activated and working fine. Stay tuned to live blog and dont go anywhere.
 Nov 21, 2026, 14:39 IST RSSB CET 12th Level City Slip 2026 Live: City Slip Out Website Working Slow
 The Rajasthan Staff Selection has released the city intimation slip on the official portal recruitment.rajasthan.gov.in. The website is currently working slow due to large number of candidates searching for city slip. Stay tuned to the live blog.
 Nov 21, 2026, 14:00 IST RSSB CET 12th Level City Slip 2026 Live: Exam Day Checklist
 Before leaving for the examination centre candidates must make sure they have completed the necessary preparations. The following points must be kept in mind to avoid last-minute problems during the examination- 
 Printed Admit Card: Download and print the provisional e-admit card after its release. 
 Photo Identity Proof: Carry an identity document with an updated photograph. 
 Photograph Verification: Ensure the photograph on the ID proof matches the admit card. 
 Exam Instructions: Read the examination guidelines mentioned on the hall ticket carefully. 
 Candidates must follow the reporting time and other instructions mentioned on their respective admit cards. 
 Nov 21, 2026, 13:30 IST RSSB CET 12th Level City Slip 2026 Live: No Postal Delivery of Admit Card
 The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board will not send provisional e admit cards to candidates separately through post or any other offline mode. Applicants will have to download their hall tickets themselves through their Rajasthan SSO ID. The admit card download facility can be downloaded on November 26, 2026. Candidates should download the document in advance and keep a printed copy ready for entry into the examination centre.

 Nov 21, 2026, 12:50 IST RSSB CET 12th Level City Intimation Slip 2026 Live: Important Photo ID Instructions for Candidates
 Candidates must check  the photograph printed on their identity documents before appearing for the examination. As per the examination instructions the photograph on the identity proof must match the photograph available on the admit card. Candidates whose identity documents contain photographs that are three years old or older have been advised to update them before the examination to avoid any issues at the exam centre. 
 Nov 21, 2026, 12:14 IST RSSB CET 12th Level City Intimation Slip 2026 Live: Question Paper Availability Rules
 RSSB has also stated how candidates will be able to access the question papers after the examination. Candidates will not be allowed to take the question paper with them after completing their respective shifts. Instead the board will upload the question papers from all examination shifts on its official website within 24 hours of the conclusion of the final examination.

The city slip will tell candidates in which centre there exam would be conducted. This year more than 23 Lakh applications have been recieved. Candidates are eagerly waiting for the release of city slip. Stay tuned to this live blog for more timely and quick updates.
 Nov 21, 2026, 11:00 IST RSSB CET 12th Level City Intimation Slip 2026 Live: OMR Sheet Carbon Copy Allowed
 Candidates who will appear for the RSSB CET 12th Level examination will be allowed to carry the carbon copy of their OMR answer sheet after completing the examination. This will help candidates retain a record of the answers.. However, the board has clarified that candidates will not be allowed to take the question paper home after the examination.Candidates must follow the instructions mentioned in the official examination notice. 
 Nov 21, 2026, 10:32 IST RSSB CET 12th Level City Intimation Slip 2026 Live: Where to Check CET City Slip?
 The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board is all set to released the district allotment or city intimation slip today November 21, 2026. All those candidates who have applied for the Common Eligibility Test can download and access the city through the recruitment portal at recruitment.rajastahn.gov.in. For this they have to enter their application number and password correctly. Stay tuned to this live blog for more recent updates.
 Nov 21, 2026, 10:00 IST RSSB CET 12th Level City Slip 2026 Live: Check Exam Pattern
 Candidates who will appear for the upcoming Rajasthan CET must be aware of the exam pattern. The test would be conducted in the offline mode. The 12th level examination consists of multiple choice questions for 240 marks . Candidates are allotted  2 hours and 30 minutes to complete their exam. There will be a negative marking of ⅓ for an incorrect attempt. Check the exam pattern in the table below.

 Nov 21, 2026, 07:25 IST RSSB CET 12th Level City Slip 2026 Live: Check Shift Timings
 The RSSB CET 12th Level examination will be conducted from December 1 to 3, 2026. The examination will take place in two shifts each day. Candidates must check their admit cards for details related to the examination date, shift and reporting time. The exam schedule is given below. 
 Morning Shift: 10:00 AM to 12:30 PM 
 Evening Shift: 3:00 PM to 5:30 PM 
 Examination Duration: 2 hours 30 minutes per shift 
 Nov 21, 2026, 07:09 IST Rajasthan CET 12th Level City Slip 2026 Live: What Details Will Be Available on the CET Exam City Slip?
 The RSSB CET 12th Level City Intimation Slip will help candidates to know their allotted examination district before the written examination. Candidates can then check the details displayed on the portal. The district information will help to plan the travel arrangements in advance. However, candidates must remember that the city intimation slip is not the admit card and does not provide the final examination centre address.

The board will provide the district allotment details through its candidate information or latest news section. Once the link is activated candidates must visit the portal and follow the instructions to check their allotted examination district. 
 Nov 21, 2026, 06:53 IST RSSB CET 12th Level City Slip 2026 Live: City Slip Expected Today
 The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) will release the CET 12th Level City Intimation Slip 2026 today November 21, 2026. Candidates who have applied for the examination can then check the allotted examination district through the official website. The board will activate the district allotment link online. Candidates are advised to keep their registration details ready to access the exam city information once the link becomes available. 
 Rajasthan CET 12th Level City Slip 2026: What's Next? 
 After the release of the district allotment details on November 21, 2026. RSSB will release the admit card on November 26, 2026. Candidates must remember that the city intimation slip would provide the advance information about the examination district and is not the admit card. Candidates are advised to keep  checking the official website for further announcements and admit card updates.
